WAVE_1_RESULT.data_independence_verdict: PARTIALLY DEPENDENT, and not an external replication. Shared material, declared by paper 2 itself (Methods 4.1: the MEF clones 'were isolated from individual mouse embryos as described before [7]', ref 7 = PMID 27869163 resolved from the artefact): four of paper 2's five clones (WT4, WT7, KO3, KO5) are paper 1's; WT3 is new; same Wwox antibody lineage (Guler 2004 / 'Huebner Lab'), same-lot status unsettleable from the artefacts. Authorship overlap is exactly TWO of 13 and 7 authors, Aldaz and Huebner: same laboratory, different hands. INDEPENDENT on species (paper 1's four repair reporters are human lines and are untouched by the shared MEFs), on method for the same step (foci inference vs direct SMART resection tracts), on reagent provenance for the decisive genetics (Parvin group vs Ludwig and Baer laboratories - two different externals), and on endpoint class. NOT mutually corroborating on the mechanism: paper 2 shows Brca1 exon 11 is DISPENSABLE in mouse and maps the interaction to the BRCT domain, against paper 1's WW1-to-exon-11/981PPLF984 mapping in human - different binding surfaces for the same protein pair, so the 2022 paper is not a mouse replication of the 2017 mechanism. ZERO external replication: every experiment in both papers is one laboratory's, and the only external contributions are reagents and mouse lines, not measurements. The nearest external voice is COUNTER-evidence the 2022 paper itself prints (Reczek: ablating Brca1-CtIP does not affect pRPA foci), answered with a hypothesis and unread here. And the programme has THREE papers: PMID 34998176 is the human-cell arm, is reference 17 of PMID 38499540, and is UNREAD in this corpus - so the human/mouse parallel both papers assert is anchored in a paper nobody here has opened.
WAVE_1_RESULT.transfer_verdict: ABSENT toward the reference genotype, and JOINTLY WEAKER than either paper alone. No neural cell, no developmental stage, no post-natal timepoint, no behaviour, no WWOX-DEE allele in either paper; every system is a cancer, immortalised or embryonic-fibroblast line and every intervention is IR, bleomycin, cisplatin, carboplatin, a Chk2 inhibitor or siRNA. The load-bearing point is paper 2's own species finding: human and mouse WWOX-BRCA1 use DIFFERENT binding surfaces, so mouse WWOX-repair results are LESS transferable to human genotype reasoning after this pair than before it. Both therapeutic proposals (HDR inhibition + radiation; Chk2 inhibition + IR/carboplatin) are explicitly NOT carried across: their mechanism of benefit is the selective killing of WWOX-deficient cells. BLOCCO 1 not engaged - neither paper makes a clinical proposition toward the reference genotype. PREMISE: DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK on any assumption that a DEE missense or splice allele behaves like the nulls and knockdowns used throughout.
